sources.quote:
Our latest flagship `Grok 3` models are now generally available via
the API. For more info, see [models](/developers/models).
sources.supports: Provider release notes establish Grok 3 API availability by April 2025, but do not give prices or caching rates.

sources.quote: Cached tokens are billed at the **cached prompt token price**, which is substantially lower than the regular prompt token price. The exact rates vary by model — check the [Pricing](/developers/pricing) page for current prices.
sources.supports: Provider says cached-token pricing is model-specific; this current documentation does not establish when the Grok 3 Fast cached rates began.

notes: The available provider sources establish that Grok 3 was available through the API and that cached tokens have model-specific discounted rates, but they do not show the historical Grok 3 Fast cache rates or when they took effect. Internet Archive CDX requests returned HTTP 503, so no before/after pricing snapshots were available; the classification and effective date therefore remain unclear.
